summary: AccumulatorEngine: build()/build_all() construct a Lattice of maximal consistent rule combinations by level-wise expansion; apply()/apply_auto() evaluate a context against a lattice (or route it via LatticeIndex).
extension_points: build_all + index(lattices) -> LatticeIndex routes CONTEXT_KEY-partitioned contexts to the correct lattice.
lifecycle_notes: Renamed/relocated from top-level accumulator_engine.py to engines/accumulator/engine.py.
Apply-phase caching added: memoised filter engines and LatticeIndex per lattice (WeakKeyDictionary).

Ternary + specificity partition routing via an embedded meta-engine added for CONTEXT_KEY dimensions (feature/ternary-partition-routing, PR #48/#49) — NOT_SET fill for missing/null partition-key fields, EXACT_KEY match strategy powers the routing.
Each build level is materialised via relation(...).collect(); do not infer lazy streaming of the entire combination search.
At target source, apply delegates to a cached ExpressionRulesEngine built from constraint dimensions only. A context-key-only lattice can be built, but its apply filter rejects empty dimensions.
The delegated filter now validates explicit dimension projections. Unchanged accumulator source does not imply unchanged behavior of its shared filter dependency.
documentation_hooks: README.md: Accumulator Engine documents the apply-phase constraint-dimension requirement.
Explain build-time partitioning separately from apply-time filter validation.
risks: `import polars as pl` with an '# allow:' tag for the empty-build schema seed — one of three documented backend-purity exemptions, pending backend-agnostic empty-frame support in mountainash.

evidence.detail: AccumulatorEngine._build_apply_metadata, apply and _filter_engine_for remap only constraint dimensions and delegate evaluation; the native Polars import seeds empty-build schemas.
ExpressionRulesEngine.__init__ rejects an empty configured dimension set; _active_dimensions rejects empty, duplicate or malformed explicit projections.
